settings.title: Inbox settings
settings.subtitle: Connect the Facebook Page whose Messenger chats come here
settings.stepsTitle: Before you start — in your Meta app
settings.step1: On developers.facebook.com, create an app with the “Engage with customers on Messenger” use case, in the same business portfolio as your Page.
settings.step2: App settings → Basic: add an icon, a privacy policy URL and a data deletion URL, then copy the App Secret.
settings.step3: Messenger → API settings → Generate access tokens: connect your Page, copy its Page ID and generate the Page access token.
settings.step4: Paste them below and save. Then paste the Callback URL and Verify token we show you into Configure webhooks.
settings.step5: Click Add subscriptions on your Page and tick messages and message_echoes. Then publish the app.
settings.pageIdHint: The number under your Page's name in Messenger API settings.
settings.tokenHint: Starts with EAA. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
settings.secretHint: App settings → Basic → App secret. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
settings.webhookHint: In your Meta app: Messenger → API settings → Configure webhooks. Paste these two values and click Verify and save.
settings.webhookNotVerified: Facebook has not checked the webhook yet
settings.subscribeHint: Then click Add subscriptions next to your Page and tick messages and message_echoes.
settings.disconnectDescription: New messages will stop arriving. Chats already received stay here, and reconnecting the same Page continues them.
